CLASS 46 · EARLY ADDITION & SUBTRACTION · SUM 29 OF 30

10 - 7

The card even asks the question for you — it prints a "?" after the equals! Seven out the door, and the ones waving goodbye are the answer, hiding in plain sight.

On the card

10 - 7 — a purple 10 at an open door while purple 7s march out and a yellow 3 waves. The equation prints with the answer blank on purpose: working it out is the game.

Try it today

Put 10 raisins on your plate, munch 7 — count the last survivors before you eat them too.

Keep going

10 - 7 is sum 29 of 30 in the Early Addition & Subtraction class. Print it for the fridge, then hop back to the class page for the next sum on the shelf.
